title: Word problems
info: Read the whole problem before you calculate. Look for how many groups, and whether you should add, subtract, or multiply.
Draw a quick picture if it helps.

questions.q: Sam has 3 bags with 4 apples in each bag. How many apples?
A notebook costs 8 dollars. You pay with 10 dollars. How much change?
5 friends each get 2 pencils. How many pencils is that?
There are 14 stickers. Half of them are blue. How many are blue?
Lia reads 6 pages on Monday and 5 pages on Tuesday. How many pages in all?
6 birds are on a fence. 3 fly away. How many are left?
